claim_text: Der Spiegel reports that SAP fell victim to a hacker attack
summary: Der Spiegel's headline of Nov 26 says SAP fell victim to a hacker attack. Its summary says SAP is dealing with an incident, according to Der Spiegel's information, and that the attackers may have had help from AI systems.
detail: The full article is for subscribers; only its headline, summary and picture caption ("active security incident") are public. The dts news agency reports the article's account.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Der Spiegel's public headline reads "SAP wird Opfer von Hackerangriff"; dts reports the same account.

claim_text: SAP says it found suspicious activity and immediately took steps to protect its customers
summary: SAP told the German news agency dpa that it had identified suspicious activity and had "immediately taken the necessary measures to protect its customers and ensure the security of its services".
detail: SAP gave the same reply when Der Spiegel asked, according to dts. No statement has been found on SAP's own website.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: dpa quotes SAP: "unverzüglich die notwendigen Maßnahmen ergriffen, um seine Kunden zu schützen"; dts reports the same reply to Der Spiegel.

claim_text: The suspicious activity was on SAP's GitHub platform for developer productivity and software delivery
summary: dpa saw part of an internal message in which SAP told staff, some days before Nov 26, of suspicious activity "within our platform for developer productivity and software delivery, GitHub". Staff were asked to check their credentials.
detail: GitHub is a widely used service where software developers store and work on code.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: dpa quotes the internal message it saw; dts reports Der Spiegel's account from company sources that the attackers targeted SAP on GitHub.

claim_text: An insider cited by Der Spiegel says the attackers stole SAP employees' login tokens and used them to change and copy SAP source code on GitHub
summary: According to an insider cited by Der Spiegel, the attackers stole authentication tokens belonging to SAP employees and used them to manipulate and copy SAP source code on GitHub.
detail: An authentication token lets a program act as a signed-in user. SAP has not commented on this detail.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: dts reports it from Der Spiegel: "Einem Insider zufolge soll es den Angreifenden gelungen sein, sogenannte Authentifizierungs-Token von SAP-Mitarbeitern zu stehlen".

claim_text: Der Spiegel reports that the attackers may have used AI
summary: Der Spiegel says the attackers may have had help from AI systems; dts, reporting the article, says possibly from "agentic" AI, meaning AI tools that carry out tasks on their own.
detail: Nobody has said what the AI is supposed to have done. SAP has not commented on it.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Der Spiegel's public summary says so; dts reports it.

claim_text: SAP calls the incident "Project Granite" internally and told staff it is an active IT security incident
summary: Der Spiegel, as reported by dts, says an internal message to staff describes an "active IT security incident" and that the company handles it under the code name "Project Granite".
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Der Spiegel's headline names "Project Granite" and its picture caption reads "active security incident"; dts reports the internal message.

claim_text: Reports differ on whether SAP has confirmed an attack
summary: dts says SAP confirmed the cyberattack when Der Spiegel asked, without answering detailed questions. dpa says that Der Spiegel wrote of a hacker attack and that SAP did not at first confirm that.
detail: SAP's own words in both reports speak of suspicious activity, not of an attack.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: dts: "Das Unternehmen bestätigte den Cyberangriff auf Anfrage des Spiegel"; dpa: "Der Konzern bestätigte dies zunächst nicht".

claim_text: SAP says it has found no sign so far that anyone got into its customers' business data
summary: SAP says: "According to the current state of our investigation, we have found no indication of unauthorised access to customers' business data."
detail: SAP's own word; nobody outside the company has checked it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: dpa quotes SAP: "keine Hinweise auf einen unbefugten Zugriff auf Geschäftsdaten von Kunden gefunden"; dts reports the same.

claim_text: SAP has not said what the activity was, when it was found or what is affected
summary: SAP has not said what kind of activity it found, when it was discovered or which areas are affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: dpa: "Welcher Art die Aktivitäten waren, wann sie entdeckt wurden und welche Bereiche betroffen sind, ließ SAP offen"; dts says SAP did not answer detailed questions.

claim_text: SAP is a Walldorf-based software maker best known for business software that runs processes such as finance, HR and sales
summary: dpa describes SAP as a Walldorf software maker and one of Germany's largest companies, known above all for its ERP software, which maps business processes in areas such as finance, HR and sales.
detail: Using SAP is not the same as being affected: no organisation has said it was affected by this incident.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: dpa's report says SAP "ist vor allem für seine Software zur Unternehmenssteuerung (ERP) bekannt, mit der Geschäftsprozesse etwa in den Bereichen Finanzen, Personal oder Vertrieb abgebildet werden können".
